reviewer: independent modeling_ui agent; did not author reviewed backend/service files
scope: Read-only review of codex_sculpt provider, service routing and backend tests. Self-authored workbench/parameter UI excluded.
checks: Version-2 organic plan schema is separate from v1 primitive plans and accepts data only; strict fields, finite coordinates and bounded budgets reject executable or unrecognized data
Up to two ordered images retain source/reference roles and strength; content digests determine distinct-reference count rather than duplicate attachments
Text-only and single-view jobs retain plausible-generation/backfill policy; multiple distinct images constrain inference while hidden surfaces remain ambiguous; exact recovery is never claimed
CLI structured-output invocation disables image generation, shell, web and external tools; incomplete, failed or forbidden-tool receipts are rejected before Blender execution
Fixed trusted Blender builder runs with factory-startup and disable-autoexec; model output is never executable Python; builder digest, GLB content and measured quality receipt bind publication
Separate sculpt provider identity, config keys, storage and run snapshots preserve existing Godot-modeling, image and legacy provider modes
Lease heartbeats use separate SQLite rows, atomic terminal transitions remain immutable, cancellation survives reopen and uncertain workers cannot silently replay CLI requests
Readiness reports runtime connection only and explicitly leaves person, organic-form and occlusion quality for actual result inspection
12 backend tests independently passed without skips, including synthetic CLI plus real installed Blender mesh, quality receipt and recovery
14 independent service-routing checks passed with mocked CLI status and real Blender --version; ComfyUI endpoint calls were prohibited and never made

evidence.dependency_recheck: Builder changed during initial evidence assembly. Full 12-test backend suite rerun passed against final recorded builder hash; source hashes checked unchanged after rerun.

required: Actual GPT CLI complex-character generation with visible face and limb structure
Actual organic-form generation and useful continuous topology
Actual reference-driven hidden-surface completion and front/back/side visual inspection
business_acceptance.note: Synthetic CLI ellipsoid test and runtime readiness do not satisfy these user-facing acceptance items; original issue remains open until actual results are verified.

limitations: Two-image unit tests establish attachment, role and digest handling only, not visual multi-view fidelity
Measured connected-manifold, volume and triangle constraints do not establish anatomical or artistic quality
No review of self-authored UI changes and no claim that complex business acceptance is complete
